title: Library of Orthanc
text: <keyword>Shadow:</keyword> Play an <symbol>isengard</symbol> minion to stack the top card of your draw deck on this card. <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> Remove <symbol>twilight1</symbol> and discard a Free Peoples card stacked here to make an <symbol>isengard</symbol> minion strength +1. <keyword>Regroup:</keyword> Remove <symbol>twilight1</symbol> to take an <symbol>isengard</symbol> card stacked here into hand.
